Original HEFSP adopted June 23, 2025; Amended HEFSP adopted March 12, 2026 (incorporating mediation results from four challengers). Oakland is in NJ Highlands; durational adjustment granted due to lack of sewer infrastructure. Round 3 mechanisms carried forward: Municipal Sponsored Construction (Block 1901 Lot 14), Bi-County (Block 3001), Fanale/K. Hovnanian (Block 4202 Lots 1-3), W. Oakland Ave 1 (Block 1706 Lot 4.01), W. Oakland Ave 2 (Block 1707 Lot 2), Terhune Site (Block 1802 Lot 1), Raritan Ave Site (Block 4004 Lots 8-9), DT-1 Zone, DT-2 Zone. Round 4 new mechanisms: DT-1 density increase (22 du/ac, 20% set-aside per Ord 26CODE984); DT-2 set-aside revision (15 du/ac, 20% set-aside per Ord 26CODE985); McBride/Hovan property rezoning RA-6AH (Block 3301 Lot 2 + Block 3401 Lots 11,12,19,40-43,52,53,57,58 — max 240 units, 20% affordable per Ord 26CODE986); Leone Brothers/McCoy Road rezoning RA-7AH (Block 4004 Lots 4-5 — max 85 units, 20% affordable per Ord 26CODE987). Also: Terhune site/Ropper-Oakland (Block 1802 Lot 1) in RA-5AH zone (17 aff units) per Amended HEFSP.
